chemistryHint.ammonia: Waste from feed and stock. Harmful when high.
chemistryHint.un_ionized_ammonia: The toxic part of ammonia. Rises with pH and warmth.
chemistryHint.nitrite: Builds up when oxygen is low. Harmful to stock.
chemistryHint.nitrate: End product of the cycle. Builds up slowly.
chemistryHint.alkalinity: Holds pH steady. Low alkalinity means bigger pH swings.
chemistryHint.salinity: Falls with rain, rises as water evaporates.
chemistryHint.turbidity: Cloudiness from algae, silt or rain.
